ai_summary: BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited announced a provisional 45% year-over-year business growth for the Q3 FY27 festive season (October 1 to November 8, 2026), primarily driven by increased buyer transactions. This strong performance indicates robust consumer demand and effective market penetration during a critical sales period, suggesting positive momentum for the ongoing quarter. However, investors should note that these figures are unaudited, interim, and subject to final audit review, which could lead to adjustments.
